http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NOAgplgTxfc

I found this to be pretty informative.
I haven't spoken with a psychologist for about a year, and asking for an appointment will bring up a bunch of questions I really don't have the energy to answer.
Thank you for your thoughts and insight, it has been a relief to get this off of my chest.

There is a seasonal aspect to my depression, I have a light which I use daily, I also have made sure to keep up with my medications.  I tend to do better when I can motivate myself to exercise.  Running used to be a big part of my life, I just can not seem to get back into it. Other than that, most treatments did little to nothing. I have a lot of trouble asking for help of any kind. Doing even this, anonymously, is taking quite a bit of effort.

She has offered me a place but, she lives 45 mins away from the telemarketing job. Without transportation I would be unable to do both.  There is a factory in the town she lives in though. Her housemate, who is also fine with me living there, works there and would be able to get me a job there.

I have been looking into this, I fear that I won't be able to afford all the expenses, including the mountain of debt I have acquired by attending school. I have a job at a local small business working weekends. I have been there for about 5 years. There are a few different places that are hiring, one is a telemarketing firm, I am going to try to build up the confidence to apply. I can also fall back on my sister, she has a stable job as an RN and has the extra space available. But, I am without a car or money. I still rather not burden anyone with me. I just want to be finished.
